⚠ CONTENT WARNING — STAR LION 2

This is a horror game wearing a cheerful costume. It starts bright and friendly and gets quietly unnerving: unsettling images, glitch effects, and things that shouldn't be there. Later chapters have light, stylized gore (crayon-red scratches, torn felt, ink drops, ribbon props) - never realistic, never lingering, never self-harm. Set GORE to SOFT to grey it all out.

The opening. The game begins with a short, gentle prologue (Prologue: Before the Name): a small cub alone in his den at night while muffled, wordless voices argue behind a wall. Nothing is shown and nothing violent happens, but it is meant to feel heavy.

Jump scares. A few moments play a sudden sting of sound, and once a face cuts onto the whole screen with a loud sting. Volume is capped, but it is meant to startle. Turn AUDIO SCARES off below to replace them with a soft cue and a slow, small, quiet reveal instead of the hard cut.

Photosensitivity. Glitch passes, quick flashes and single-frame images may affect people with photosensitive epilepsy. REDUCE FLASHING turns all of them off.

Motion. Some moments shake the screen. REDUCE MOTION keeps it still.

A safe spot. The Purring Pot cat cafe in the village is a cozy break: no scares there, just visitors, tea and a cafe to run.

Every "crash", error, patch note and purchase screen is fake and stays inside this page. Nothing is bought and nothing touches your device. You can leave any time with ◀ HUB or your browser's back button. You can change these settings any time in the top bar or the in-game OPTIONS.
